sources.hint: Add your own personal source lists here. Kartouche does not provide, host, or reference any list or downloadable content: choosing, adding, and the legality of each source are entirely your responsibility.
sources.formatIntro: A source list is a JSON document following the "kartouche.sourcelist/v1" format: a name, and a list of entries, each tied to a console and one or more download links.
sources.formatFields: Optional fields: "homepage" and "generatedAt" for the document; "sizeBytes", "hash" and "note" for an entry. "hash" (crc32/sha1) is only a quick sanity filter before a large download — the file's real integrity is checked afterwards against the catalog.

play.quickExitFirmware: The firmware for this console is missing or invalid.
play.quickExit3dsCrypto: Azahar detects this game as encrypted and refuses to launch it, no matter which keys you supply (it has blocked all encrypted content outside the eShop/System Settings since late 2024). The file is probably not actually decrypted despite its name: dump your own cartridge (GodMode9), or reinstall from a .cia redownloaded from the eShop.
play.quickExitVitaminDump: Vita3K refuses this file: it's a Vitamin-format dump, an old tool known to corrupt saves and break games, which the emulator blocks outright. Re-dump the game in NoNpDrm format.
play.quickExitNoLog: No log could be retrieved. Open the emulator directly to see the error message.
play.sbiFailed: That file could not be added (check that it is really a .sbi).
